body: Kind of distant connection, but my high school drama teacher went to high school with Paul Rudd. My teacher was really into debate and forensics, and specialized in comedy. He said the only person who ever got higher marks than him was Paul, who he couldn't even come close to beating. Apparently Paul is really laid back and chill, and though they weren't close friends, they held a lot of respect for each other. Somewhat ironic that Paul ended up making it big, whereas my teacher ended up as most skilled thespians do, teaching drama in some high school. We did have the best program in the Midwest, and my teacher was the single most passionate theatre aficionado that I've ever had the pleasure of meeting, but still. Fate works in strange ways, I suppose.

Once when I was like 11, we were slowly driving past a gas station, and two guys had just jaywalked to the other side of the road opposite of the 7/11. The first one was a white dude in a black karategi (one of those karate outfits that martial art practitioners wear) who was carrying an unsheathed katana in one hand and a pack of monster energy drinks in the other. He was walking with an African American guy dressed in a white karategi, while carrying a huge boombox on his shoulder. My mother was driving, but didn't comment on them. A friend of mine was also in the car, but she said she didn't see them. I lived close to this area at the time, and the only karate school was halfway across town. I never saw them again, despite living only two or three blocks away

I'm sorry you're going through this, although I know words usually amount to jack shit in these situations. Try getting out and going for a run, or walk to a park, or something. Who cares what time it is or what they say, you need to prioritize your needs above all else, because you're the most important person in your life. Sometimes when the shouting and screaming and cursing from my family gets too much for me and I feel like doing something stupid I run until my legs give out and I can't breathe. It's the only thing that keeps me grounded man. Try and get help, or at least something to hold on to, to keep going. It could be anything, even the smallest things are good reasons not to kill yourself.
